description: Run real tasks on live websites over plain HTTP.

tools.name: library_get
tools.description: Read-only, touches no site, costs nothing. Returns the `bowmark.*` functions, their arguments and return types for the task. A query that matches nothing returns the index rather than an error. Markdown by default; send `Accept: application/json` for JSON. Optional: query.

params.name: query
params.description: The task or the site's hostname (`flights`, `amazon.com`). Repeat it for a task with several parts (`?query=flights&query=hotels`), up to 6.

tools.name: recipes_get
tools.description: Read one recipe, including its script. Required: id. Returns the RecipesGetResponse. (public)

tools.name: recipes_list
tools.description: List ready-made scripts. Returns array of Recipe. (public)

tools.name: recipes_run
tools.description: The body is the recipe's inputs as a JSON object. Same envelope, billing and status codes as `POST /v1/run`. Required: id. Returns the new RunEnvelope.

tools.name: run_run
tools.description: The script is the body of an async function: use `await` freely and `return` the result. It runs in a sandbox with the `bowmark` global and `log()`. Read `GET /v1/library` first for the exact function names. Required: script. Optional: egress. Returns the new RunEnvelope.

params.name: egress
params.description: Optional. `link` sends every request of the run through your own Chrome (Bowmark Link) and fails with 'Link not connected' when it is not open, never falling back to Bowmark's route. Any other value is a 400.

tools.name: scripts_delete
tools.description: Delete one of your saved scripts. Required: ref. Returns the ScriptsDeleteResponse. Destructive.

params.name: ref
params.description: The script's id or its name.

tools.name: scripts_get
tools.description: Read one of your saved scripts. Required: ref. Returns the SavedScript.

params.name: ref
params.description: The script's id or its name.

tools.name: scripts_list
tools.description: List your saved scripts. Returns array of SavedScript.

tools.name: scripts_save
tools.description: Saves a script you can later run by its id or name with `POST /v1/scripts/{ref}/run`. Saving over a name you already used replaces its script and keeps its id. The script is checked when you save it, so one that does not parse is refused here. Inside it, `input` is the object the run passes. Scripts belong to you, not to one key: every key on your account sees the same ones. Required: name, script. Optional: description. Returns the new SavedScript.

tools.name: scripts_run_script
tools.description: `input` is the object the script reads as `input`. Same envelope, billing and status codes as `POST /v1/run`. Required: ref. Optional: input. Returns the new RunEnvelope.

params.name: ref
params.description: The script's id or its name.

tools.name: sites_call-function
tools.description: The body is the function's arguments as an object keyed by parameter name. The site's own spec has the exact shape for each function. Same envelope, billing and status codes as `POST /v1/run`. Required: site, fn. Returns the new RunEnvelope.

tools.name: sites_list
tools.description: Every site with its own functions. Each row carries `openapiUrl`, that site's own spec. Returns array of SitesListItem. (public)

tools.name: sites_openapi-json_get-site-spec
tools.description: An OpenAPI 3.1 document with one operation per function of that site, each a `POST /v1/sites/{site}/{fn}`. Feed it to an SDK generator for a typed client. Required: site. Returns the OpenapiJsonGetSiteSpecResponse. (public)

params.name: site
params.description: A site id from `GET /v1/sites` (`kayak`) or the site's host (`kayak.com`).
